prior_summary: Diffuse redundant target-frame and fresh-TCP descriptions of commanded position, use target-frame displacement equivariance through approach and most of the pull, then smoothly favor local fresh-TCP residual position near the open stop; orientation is always a fresh-TCP body correction.
applicable_conditions: Prefer when target_pose reliably tracks a translated or rotated drawer and the state is near a demonstrated approach, opening or departure phase. Use especially when early drawer displacement invariance and locally referenced near-stop continuation are both desired.
termination_guidance: Hand off after drawer_position is near 0.300 m with low velocity, fingers are open, the TCP has cleared the drawer and is moving toward or above the unchanged block. Preserve causal history across the switch.
limitations: Only early/pull position is drawer-frame equivariant; orientation remains TCP-relative and the late tail is not block-frame invariant. The progress blend has no hysteresis. No recovery, reachability, collision-clearance or contact guarantee follows from relative coordinates or in-distribution validation.

config.action_layout: target-frame position 3 + measured-TCP body translation 3 + body rotation vector 3 + gripper 1
